children: none, because all three candidates belong to THIS voyage and splitting them would ship a breach. (a) The verdict-change door is not a child: falsifier clause (1) makes the collapse illegal without it, so they land together or not at all. (b) Retiring the hash chain and the probe it feeds (cairn/devices/tester/probes/the_door_is_the_only_path_in_practice.py) is not a child: leaving that probe armed against a key nothing writes makes the ground loop fire a false finding forever, so the retirement is same-act. (c) The artifact/quorum path (validations_path_for_artifact, quorum.py) is not a child but a BOUND — it is scoped OUT, measured at 0 specimens in 90 trails, and build-minimal refuses a rule written against zero. Its reopener is an event on the record: the first quorum-sealed artifact trail, at which point this node's horizon has arrived and it is re-cast, not amended.

questions.a: ACCUMULATE WHERE A NAMED READER ASKS A CROSS-RUN QUESTION, AND THE READER MUST EXIST. This reconciles the node with ticket the-proof-record-persists-so-runs-can-be-compared, which wants accumulation and is not in conflict: it has a named reader ('which checks have never redded') and is building the store for it; the validation trail has none, measured at zero. The rule outlives this node.

LAW 7 IS SURVIVED BY THE SECOND HALF, NOT WAVED PAST. persist_validation's docstring calls the trail a record of truth under Law 7, and Law 7's why is that an error must not be smoothed into a coherent shape. The test is whether the collapse makes an error QUIETER: today a red sits at index 1 of a 16-entry file nothing reads; under this design a verdict change fires out a door at the moment it happens, into a store that really is append-only. Louder, not quieter — but only with the change-door, which is why falsifier clause (1) is exactly that and why this cast spawns no children.

A CHECK THAT GOES RED AT THE MOMENT ITS CONDITION IS SATISFIED, third instance. Retiring the chain would leave the_door_is_the_only_path_in_practice counting TRAIL_LINK absence in a world where nothing writes TRAIL_LINK — firing forever on a finding false by construction. Caught at the cast rather than in flight; its retirement is bound into this voyage.

CC'S NEAR-MISS, RECORDED BECAUSE THE REASONING IS THE REUSABLE PART: a digest-only spine was nearly designed, keeping each superseded record's 64-byte trail_link so the chain would still verify. That is preserving a mechanism after its job has ended, dressed as thrift. The chain's job was append-only-ness, and append-only-ness is the thing being dropped.

watchme.trigger: at least 20 validations have landed since the collapse, AND at least one validation trail in class-space holds more than one record. Files only: glob **/validations/*.json under the class-space root, count records, count post-collapse-dated ones.
watchme.enough: 20 or more validations landed since the collapse AND every trail holds exactly one record. THE FLOOR SITS ON BOTH CLAUSES DELIBERATELY: without it on the clear side, an empty post-collapse corpus has no multi-record trail in it and the watch would retire on its first pulse before a single seal landed — the asymmetry that let does_optional_mean_never_carried clear at n=1 against a corpus of one ticket, itself.

cairn/devices/tester/probes/the_door_is_.why: RETIRED BY THIS TICKET'S OWN CAST, and its question moved rather than ended — which is why this is a forwarding entry and not drift. The retired probe counted validation entries carrying no `trail_link`; this voyage retired the hash chain, so that key is written by nothing and the probe would have read a corpus-wide zero forever, firing on a finding false by construction. Its question — did anybody go around the door — is carried at the successor by one observation: a validations file holding more than one record IS a write that did not come through the door. THE SUCCESSOR IS MEASURED, NOT ASSERTED: the carry is written into the surviving probe's own docstring (the ONE INSTRUMENT, AND NOW ONE PROBE paragraph), so a reader can check the claim at the far end, and the gate re-checks both ends at every promotion. The survey berth survey-20260816T134157-0dde83d302e9.json charted the retired address as holding 9, correctly, hours before the build removed it; berths are records of truth and are not edited to look consistent. Same shape as ticket watchme-emits-a-probe, 2026-07-30, whose own decompose falsified its own chart by succeeding.
